evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep skips straight into 'do you have any important concerns aside from the price' without the time-boxed framing or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Jackie), moving day (Tuesday), route (east Dallas to storage on Ross Ave), items (sectional, chairs, nightstands, dresser, boxes, mattress TBD) — all four asked before concern check.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after customer had already given background: 'before we start do you have any important concerns aside from the price' — but customer had already begun describing the move.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about Tuesday availability and cancellation flexibility. Rep acknowledged but did not probe deeper ('tell me more about that') — moved straight to process explanation.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection of concerns. Rep acknowledged but never reflected back: 'So what I'm hearing is...'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (home), stories (two story), parking (driveway), storage details (indoor climate-controlled, has elevator), walking distance noted as unknown but acknowledged as affecting time — nearly all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Asked: 'everything's all the boxes already packed. Good to go. Is that right?' Customer declined.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. No mention of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Gave hourly rate ($204/hr for two movers, $102 per mover) and minimum ($510 for 2.5 hours), plus estimate bump to 3 hours ($612) based on unknown storage details — range provided but not anchored to a 'typical home this size' and personalization was minimal (just noted lack of storage clarity).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full framing delivered: 'two and a half hour minimum,' '15 minute intervals,' all-inclusive rate (no hidden fees, no credit card fees, fuel, stairs, taxes, insurance), time clock starts at pickup. No trip fee or overnight fee mentioned, but not applicable to this move.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moved directly to cancellation policy after laying out pricing without checking if estimate felt fair.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered: 'on time guarantee if we run late on the window we provide you, then we provide discounts for you.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Fully delivered: 'no worse damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for an accident of damages' — though the 'no deductible/no fine print' framing is absent, coverage and $2K amount are clear.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep never asked 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirmed the Two Promises closed the customer's concerns.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep ended with 'Alright thank you so much and have a good day' without asking 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was asked.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep said 'If you're ready to go ahead with the booking just let us know' (soft, passive) and 'I'll go ahead and send everything in the email' — no plain 'Would you like our help with your move?' and no explicit request for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No framing that the rate is locked in or good through a specific date.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Arrival window confirmed (8:30–9:00 AM or 1:00–3:00 PM Tuesday), customer confirmed no cancellation fee, but date/phone/addresses/crew size/notes not all confirmed in a booking summary. Email quote promised but no full booking confirmation loop completed on the call.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, stairs, storage amenities, parking, distance concerns) and delivered complete pricing and Two Promises transparency, giving the customer clear pricing framing and no-hidden-fee confidence.
coaching_note: The call lacked the essential opening quid pro quo framing, never asked 'Does that feel fair?' to pause for customer reaction to pricing, and ended without an explicit ask for the business — Joanna handed off to email follow-up instead of closing the loop on commitment.
